review_role: AI-assisted internal source-reading adjudication by a separate agent; not external or qualified human expert validation
source_and_label_independence: References prepared before reading implementation or predictions. Final source interpretation review performed after software freeze and primary evaluation; no runtime, protocol, references or primary results modified.
limitations: Scores cover selected literal declarations/reports and source equations, not complete paper understanding.
Correctly reporting a parameter standard deviation does not independently validate statistical uncertainty.
SBML parameter probes with unit null concern absent explicit parameter units attrs; contextual physical units in narrative are not thereby understood.
Five context field-placement mismatches are diagnostic observations only; primary14/22 remains unchanged.
One confidence counterprobe core hit is a grading granularity artifact; no actual confidence interval claim, full context match orauthority grant occurred.
A failed unsupported syntax dispatch couples all Misra1a source checks to model parsing; correct table transcription receives no independent numerical/checker confirmation in this final run.
Internal AI-assisted review can share systematic errors; qualified independent domain expert validation remains needed.
